status: FROZEN initial benchmark definition (labels, splits, reader). Model, preprocessing for the backbone, and thresholds are NOT frozen here.

dataset.name: PTB-XL
dataset.citation: Wagner et al., Scientific Data 7, 154 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41597-020-0495-6
dataset.separate_from: PhysioNet arrhythmia dataset and the PTB-XL-derived Challenge 2021 copy in data/raw/ptb-xl (never mixed; Challenge/PTB-XL record overlap not established)

train.use: fitting; label vocabulary and any data-dependent statistic derived here only

test_reserved.use: ONE final evaluation after every decision is frozen; no waveform access before then

labels.rule: class positive iff some diagnostic statement mapped to that superclass has likelihood >= 50; likelihood 0 (unknown) never positive
labels.records_without_positive_label: excluded from supervised diagnosis training/evaluation; kept in the manifest with exclusion_reason=no_positive_diagnostic_superclass
labels.vocabulary_derivation: ptbxl.derive_vocabulary on training records (folds 1-8); must equal the set above (checked by the manifest script)

signal_reader.format: WFDB format 16, single .dat, 12 signals, little-endian int16, sample-major, no skew/offset/samples-per-frame
signal_reader.returned: digital int16 (12, 5000) in model lead order (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1-V6), reordered by name, no calibration/filtering/normalisation

not_frozen: backbone preprocessing choice (int16 truncation quirk, scaling)
metric implementation details beyond the list in docs/PTBXL_PROTOCOL.md
